top_signals.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 28
top_signals.summary: Oil swung as strong demand for physical barrels collided with easing supply disruptions in the Middle East and progress toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz, though repeated false starts have left traders skeptical.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Putin Imposes Sweeping New Reporting Limits on Russian Energy
top_signals.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin imposed sweeping new restrictions on what can be accessed and reported about the country’s energy trade, adding a fresh layer of secrecy about activity in one of the world’s oil-and-gas producing nations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
